title: DIAMETER: Show packet "Info" and AVP in brief form
description:
Add protocol preference to display information in more compact form.

1. Column "Info" contains a lot of unnecessary information such as:
prefix "cmd=", flags, ApplicationID and etc.

In case if one frame contains multiple DIAMETER messages then it's
very difficult to understand what is second message

Example:[cca_mscc_result_code.pcap](/uploads/4e374d8f015b4bbc5ddf45bf24dade90/cca_mscc_result_code.pcap)

Before
```
cmd=Credit-Control Answer(272) flags=-P-- appl=Diameter Credit Control Application(4) h2h=4d2 e2e=10e1 | cmd=Credit-Control Request(272) flags=RP-- appl=Diameter Credit Control Application(4) h2h=8ae e2e=115c | [Malformed Packet]
```

After
```
Credit-Control Answer | Credit-Control Request | [Malformed Packet]
```

Note: I don't know why there is [Malformed Packet]. But it's not related
with this commit.

2. AVP
Every AVP parameter in tree has prefix "AVP: " and also includes information
about length and flags. It's too verbose and can be found in child items.

Before
```
AVP: Multiple-Services-Credit-Control(456) l=32 f=-M-
    AVP Code: 456 Multiple-Services-Credit-Control
    AVP Flags: 0x40, Mandatory: Set
    AVP Length: 32
    Multiple-Services-Credit-Control
        AVP: Rating-Group(432) l=12 f=-M- val=8765432
        AVP: Result-Code(268) l=12 f=-M- val=DIAMETER_CREDIT_LIMIT_REACHED (4012)

```

After
```
Multiple-Services-Credit-Control
    AVP Code: 456 Multiple-Services-Credit-Control
    AVP Flags: 0x40, Mandatory: Set
    AVP Length: 32
    Multiple-Services-Credit-Control
        Rating-Group: 8765432
        Result-Code: DIAMETER_CREDIT_LIMIT_REACHED (4012)

```

> Note: I don't know why there is [Malformed Packet].

It's malformed because the AVP 437 (Requested-Service-Unit) at the end is malformed. It's a grouped AVP (which is optional in some circumstances), and instead of having payload any of the possible AVPs it can contain, it has 4 null bytes after its header. An empty grouped AVP should have length 8 (12 if the V bit is set, which it is not.)

I fully removed Multiple-Services-Credit-Control and [Malformed Packet] was disappered
[cca_mscc_result_code.pcap](/uploads/eb4a9c16e147ff8ac4f1b855187252f4/cca_mscc_result_code.pcap)
Did you, perhaps, edit the capture originally before posting it, for privacy reasons, or was it malformed on the network?

I manualy crafted this packet by Golang package [go-diameter](https://github.com/fiorix/go-diameter). Main idea was to include two DIAMETER message in one Ethernet frame to explain that current display mode is not ver convinient.
